precondition: runs ONLY if the primary discovery returns DISCOVERY_PASS (all critical gates pass and no control satisfies all gates)

hard_rules.a_passing_neighbourhood_cell_while_the_p: POST_HOC_LEAD_ONLY - it may never be promoted and requires a NEW_HYPOTHESIS_ID and a NEW_PREREGISTRATION to be tested as anything other than a robustness diagnostic

participation_reference_length_days.rationale: the 30-day same-slot reference is the only length-like constant in the hypothesis; the grid probes whether the result is an artifact of exactly 30 days. It may not be used to pick a different reference length.

holding_bars.rationale: the mechanism asserts a transient reversal; the grid probes whether the effect is confined to a narrow horizon. It may not be used to pick a different holding period.

cost_curve_bps.role: diagnostic; already reported at discovery via G11
cost_curve_bps.trade_set: IDENTICAL to the primary; cost scenarios never regenerate signals

stability_analyses.definition: mean net return by (a) chronological halves, (b) chronological quartiles, (c) UTC calendar year
stability_analyses.convention: identical equal-count chronology to ARC03_STATISTICAL_GATES.json.temporal_split; the calendar-year split is calendar-based and reported additionally
stability_analyses.pass_interest: sign consistency, not a new threshold

stability_analyses.definition: per-asset mean net return plus a leave-one-asset-out portfolio for each of BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT
stability_analyses.convention: equal-weighted mean of the remaining assets' trade returns
stability_analyses.pass_interest: no single asset may be solely responsible for a passing result; note this is a diagnostic, not a gate (G9 is the frozen gate)

stability_analyses.definition: terciles of the causal 30-day trailing realized volatility measured strictly BEFORE the decision: for signal bar t, vol_ref(t) = sum over j = 1..30 of (high(t - 86400000*j) - low(t - 86400000*j)); terciles computed on the pooled pre-decision distribution of vol_ref
stability_analyses.causality: vol_ref uses only bars strictly older than the signal bar, so no future information enters the regime label

stability_analyses.definition: asset / month / single-trade concentration shares recomputed on the neighbourhood cells and on the leave-one-out portfolios
the full 4 (reference days) x 4 (holding bars) x 4 (cost) surface reported as a complete matrix plus the 4 x 4 matrix at the primary cost
stability_analyses.reporting_requirement: the ENTIRE surface is persisted, seeds and conventions included, so no cell can be selectively quoted
stability_analyses.interpretation_rule: the surface informs confidence in the frozen primary; it can never redefine it

stability_analyses.definition: recompute the primary result with each single asset removed and with each single calendar year removed
stability_analyses.purpose: expose dependence on one asset or one era
stability_analyses.promotion_rule: FORBIDDEN - a leave-one-out result may never become the production hypothesis

oos.reason: the ARC-03 dataset is a single certified 5m authority over one common causal window; a held-out out-of-sample period cannot be frozen without splitting the discovery window, which would change the primary trade set. The out-of-sample requirement is therefore deferred to the authorized ARC03_ROBUSTNESS_OOS_01 stage, where a walk-forward protocol must be frozen BEFORE execution and all primary parameters remain at their frozen values.
oos.forbidden: no OOS protocol may be designed after observing the primary result in a way that selects the split, the parameters or the assets

orthogonality_stage.metric: max |correlation of daily net PnL| and max trade-time Jaccard overlap
orthogonality_stage.aru_kill_rule_binding: the ARU kill rule names a collision with H5 explicitly; failing the H5 check is a FAIL-class outcome for ARC-03, not a redesign prompt
